reason: After thorough review of the Duolingo 10-K filing, the company does not disclose a self-published TAM figure. The only market sizing reference found is attributed to HolonIQ, a third-party analyst firm: 'According to HolonIQ in January 2024, consumer spend on both online and offline language learning is expected to reach about $123 billion by 2027.' Since this is external analyst data and not company-disclosed TAM, it does not meet the strict criteria for inclusion.
